unit: million EUR per year, RSA allocations paid (depenses d'allocations)
definition: Revenu de solidarite active (RSA): allocations paid in 2023, France, including the prime de Noel; after recovery of overpayments. Excludes the prime d'activite (a separate in-work benefit) and all other minima sociaux.
